# E0126: the lineage is not an instance of thema.Lineage

The lineage is not an instance of thema.Lineage, for a reason thema has no more
specific code for; CUE's own account is in the detail. Here the name is a
number where a lineage's name is a string.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: 5
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0126]: the lineage is not an instance of thema.Lineage
  --> lineage.cue:1:7
   |
 1 | name: 5
   |       ^
   |
   = note: in thema's own CUE
    --> thema/lineage.cue:26:9
   = detail: name: conflicting values 5 and =~"^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$" (mismatched types int and string)
```
